course.adab.title: Adab kee Meqe Ayyunti Barti
course.adab.subtitle: Suuratul Faatica, Suuratu-Luqhmaan kee Suuratul Cujuraat addaak Adab kee meqe ayyunti
course.adab.short_description: «Al-Mukhtasar fii Tafsiir Al-Qhur-aan Al-Kariim» kitaabak yewqe sidiica barti le dagoo barti: Suuratul Faaticat Yallah fayya tan Qibaada, Suuratu-Luqhmaanit Naggaarinna, kee Suuratul Cujuraatit Nabiyyih ﷺ adab; barti inkih lakal ixxigah esserooca.
course.adab.description: Ta barti Qhur-aan Kariim sidiica Suurat elle cedde gide Muslimih adab kee meqe ayyunti barsita, «Al-Mukhtasar fii Tafsiir Al-Qhur-aan Al-Kariim» kitaabak yewqe sahlinih tafsiiriih. Suuratul Faaticak qimbisa, toh Qibaada Yallah fayya abaanamaa kee Yallak dubuh catoo esseraanam barsita; tohuk lakal Suuratu-Luqhmaanih qimbol kee Naggaarinnaak faxa geytaah meqe taama abba marih astooti; tohuk lakal Suuratul Cujuraatih qimbol kee Yallaa kee kay Farmoytah ﷺ adab, kaadu kay foocal yab gaba haysiisaanam. Barti inkih galgalih akeeki, kay Aayatih tafsiiri kee ixxigah usuk tan esserooca le, barti gabat ellecabo qorma yan.
course.adab.lesson.1.title: Suuratul Faatica
course.adab.lesson.1.subtitle: Yallah fayya tan Qibaada · Aaya 1–7
course.adab.lesson.1.q1.text: Suuratul Faatica macah ta migaaqal migaaqoyse?
course.adab.lesson.1.q2.text: Kay {مَٰلِكِ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ} iyyeemi yabal «Yawmud-Diin» maca kinni?
course.adab.lesson.1.q3.text: Yallak nee yaktubeh nek esseraana massoosa gita maca kinni?
course.adab.lesson.2.title: Suuratu-Luqhmaan
course.adab.lesson.2.subtitle: Naggaarinna kee meqe taama abba marih astooti · Aaya 1–11
course.adab.lesson.2.q1.a: Qhur-aan addat yabbixe Naggaarinna katayaanam amrii kee kaak darre cabaanamak takkawsimaanama
course.adab.lesson.2.q2.text: Suuratu-Luqhmaanih qimbol, Yalli Kitaabih Aayat iyyah Tirtoo kee Racmatta abe?
course.adab.lesson.2.q3.text: Malcina Aayat iyyem akkal, Yallih Aayat kibrih numul akriyimtek, kay xayla maca kinni?
course.adab.lesson.2.q3.c: Ma yaabbinnoh akke inna teetik dirrigta
course.adab.lesson.3.title: Suuratul Cujuraat
course.adab.lesson.3.subtitle: Nabiyyih ﷺ adab · Aaya 1–4
course.adab.lesson.3.q1.b: Arraaba qagaaqagitaah, numih Iimaan kee ummatah ayyunti kaak tan raati baxxaqisiisa
course.adab.lesson.3.q2.text: Suuratul Cujuraat naharsi Aaya ayti adab amrisse?
course.adab.lesson.3.q2.a: Moominiin yabal aw abinal Yallaa kee kay Farmoytak foocat maakuna
course.adab.lesson.3.q2.c: Nabiyyih ﷺ foocal yab fayya haysiisaanam
course.adab.lesson.3.q3.text: Yallih Farmoytah ﷺ foocal sinni yab gaba haysiisa marih galto maca kinni?
course.adab.lesson.3.q3.c: Dambi cabtii kee nabam galto Ken le
course.adab.quiz.title: Ixxigah esserooca
course.adab.exam.title: Ellecabo qorma
course.adab.exam.q2.text: Kay {إِيَّاكَ نَعۡبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسۡتَعِينُ} iyyeemi yabal, iyyak cato esserna?
course.adab.exam.q3.text: Suuratu-Luqhmaanih qimbol, Yalli meqe taama abba mara macal weelosse?
course.adab.exam.q3.b: Salat soolisan, Zakaat yacan, Ellecabo Ayrol yaqiinih yeemenen
course.adab.exam.q4.text: Suuratul Cujuraat namma haytu Aaya maca takkawsise?
course.adab.exam.q4.a: Nabiyyih ﷺ yabak yab fayya haysiisaanamak
course.adab.exam.q5.text: Ta bartih sidiica barti macal sabba seca?
course.adab.exam.q5.b: Yallaa kee kay Farmoytah adab kee meqe ayyuntil

chat.course.title: Adab kee Meqe Ayyunti Bartih Kaxxa
chat.course.m1: Assalaamu caleykum wa racmatullaah, bartih kaxxal nagay tamaateenin. Bartih esserooca anel esserrina.
chat.course.m2: Kassiisa: Suuratul Faaticah bartik qimbisa, tohuk lakal tet lakal tan ixxigah esserooca zaabita, wohuk lakal tan barti fakkimeh.

chat.support.m1: Moddaker kal nagay tamaate, macal sin catna?
